text:
Dinesh: APAC GPU pool in ap-southeast-1 seeing sustained 30-40% RPC errors and queue buildup. Tail lat +200ms. GLB still routing ~35% there. Looks like host NIC flapping on a subset of nodes. Need to shed traffic to EU/NA while keeping latency SLOs.
Marta: On it. How stable is eu-west? Can it absorb ~35% without cascade throttles?
Sophie: EU has headroom on control plane but GPUs at ~80% for quantized endpoints. Suggest ramp EU by +10% every 2m with connection drain TTL=20s.
Kai: Agree. I'll start a gradual steer via router API. Command I will run:
`curl -XPOST https://router.redwood.internal/api/v1/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"apac":25,"eu":50,"na":25}'`
I'll canary +10% now.
Dinesh: Add automatic fallback to NA if EU util > 75%. Also temporarily disable session stickiness for affected route.
deploy-bot: router: weight update initiated by Kai — change: apac -10, eu +10, na 0. run_id: r-20260318-01. https://console.redwood.internal/routing/r-20260318-01
Nina: Cost note: shifting APAC traffic to NA will increase egress & inter-region cost ~10-15% for APAC-origin requests. I will add a cost watch.
Kai: Canary applied. Observability: https://dashboards/redwood/route/apac-steer . apac error rate dropping 15% -> 6% after 5m. EU tail latency +40ms.
Sophie: EU latency still within SLA but throughput is near threshold. If stable, continue ramp +10 in 3m.
Dinesh: Opening infra ticket for NIC flapping: infra-2026-117. Assigning to eng-infra. Also tag as P2.
Marta: Opening runbook: https://runbooks.internal/apac-nic-flap. We'll keep rotation gradual. Call if EU hits 75% or NA cost > baseline+10%.
Kai: Logged exact command used in ops channel. Reminder: do not paste bearer tokens.
deploy-bot: monitoring: alerts for apac error-rate suppressed for mitigation window (30m) per run_id r-20260318-01.
Nina: Cost alert created: metric=cost/egress-by-region, window=15m, threshold=10% above baseline.
Dinesh: Thanks team. We'll follow up with postmortem once infra stabilizes and patch appliances.
